option_relations.rationale: Malignant myopericytoma is a perivascular tumor, while Dabska tumor is a rare vascular tumor. They are distinct entities.
Glomus tumor is a benign tumor of glomus cells, which are specialized smooth muscle cells. Dabska tumor is a vascular tumor. They are unrelated.
Myoepithelial carcinoma is a malignant tumor of myoepithelial cells, often found in salivary glands. Dabska tumor is a vascular tumor. They are unrelated.
Atypical myopericytoma is a perivascular tumor with some atypical features. Dabska tumor is a vascular tumor. They are distinct entities.
